WHERE toLower(p.vendor) CONTAINS 'snyk'
AND o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won'
WITH c.sf_name AS customer_name, o.close_date AS deal_date, toFloat(o.total_price) AS amount
ORDER BY deal_date DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN customer_name, deal_date, amount
